Timestamps here are date-granular; the authoring role holds no clock, and 00:00:00Z means 'on 2026-09-22'.

BATCH-5149d8 (coordination/design/BATCH-5149d8/) is complete and its producer card carried review_required false with no review chain. The round is opened here rather than by editing a completed queue. This batch uses the canonical coordination/goals/<GOAL>/batches/ layout; GOAL-AUXIN-a93442's two previous batches sit under coordination/design/.

The object under review, RUN-AUXIN-fd1edc, was produced by TASK-20260916-3dcd7e and snapshot-recorded by TASK-20260916-89f8c7, both in BATCH-5149d8. So no card here carries review_required true and _validate_review_chains has nothing to bind; the reviewers depend instead on this batch's opening ledger archive, which commits the plan they must read. The three reviews are owned by one snapshot archive, TASK-20260922-39a32c, so composition reads committed, hash-bound reports.

TASK-20260922-09522c is a structurally blind re-derivation. No card, note, receipt, PR text or commit message of this batch may state any census number or which rows the census flagged before that task returns. Its read scope is a whitelist; its card in ledger/handoffs/ is written to that standard. Run --blind-history per batch.yaml before dispatching it.

Every card sets fallback_allowed TRUE with a reason: under this runtime subagents inherit the session model, so false would be broken by the dispatch itself (DEC-20260922-19b645 PCR-3, plan PD-R7; same reasoning as BATCH-5286b0). It permits a BACKEND substitution only. Review cards stay on review-adversarial at the policy's xhigh default with degraded_allowed false and independent sessions required.

The top-level session reports no lane registered on GOAL-AUXIN-a93442 at opening. That is a snapshot, not a lock: git fetch and tools/goal_lanes.py lanes GOAL-AUXIN-a93442 before each launch, and claim a lane per card.
